name: Snow Cap Text
description: Large text that snow falls around and settles on, gathering in soft caps along the real tops of the letters until a letter is knocked.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real text laid out by the page in the inherited font. The tops of the glyphs are measured from that font once it has loaded, and again on resize.

props.name: rate
props.description: How hard it snows. Multiplies the number of flakes and how quickly the caps build.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest a cap can grow, in pixels. Narrow tops and slopes hold less; snow slides off steep edges into the hollows.

props.name: ref
props.description: Call `shake()` to knock the snow off every letter in turn.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, an inline block. Flakes fall in a soft margin around it, so leave some room above. Other span props are passed through. Under reduced motion the plain text is shown.
